name_input: MAHARASHTRA SEAMLESS LTD.; MAHARASHTRA SEAMLESS LIMITED; MAHARASHTRA SEAMLESS LTD; MAHARASHTRA SEAMLESS LTD
court_cases: Multiple Indian proceedings found on Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=Maharashtra%20Seamless, accessed 24.11.2026): (1) Competition Commission of India v. Maharashtra Seamless Ltd, Case No. 48 of 2018 (Oil Country Tubular Ltd as informant) - company was Opposite Party before CCI; (2) Maharashtra Seamless Limited & Anr v. Competition Commission of India & Anr, Delhi High Court W.P.(C) 17348/2025 with CM APPL 71390/2025 - company is PETITIONER challenging CCI; hearings on 14.11.2025, 17.11.2025, 19.11.2025, 04.12.2025, 07.01.2026, 27.01.2026 and 19.11.2026 - status: pending/ongoing before Delhi HC; (3) Maharashtra Seamless Limited & Ors, Delhi HC W.P.(C) 19017/2025 (Forech India Pvt Ltd v. Inder Pal Singh Bindra) - related CCI-linked writ, pending; (4) Maharashtra Seamless Limited v. Padmanabhan Venkatesh, Supreme Court, 22.01.2020 (AIR 2020 SC 3779) - company was successful Resolution Applicant for Seamless Tubulaar Pvt Ltd, i.e. claimant/appellant, not defendant; (5) NCLAT Appeal (AT) No. 220 of 2019, Indian Bank v. V. Venkatachalam, company as appellant; (6) ITAT Delhi, DCIT v. Maharashtra Seamless Ltd, ITA 6458/Del/2015 (AY 2009-10) - tax appeal, company as respondent; (7) several CESTAT Mumbai excise/customs appeals (2011, 2014, 2019) - company as appellant. No criminal case against the company or its promoters was found in the sources reviewed. Per project rule 2, these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds.
news_risk: Regulatory: CCI proceedings (Case No. 48 of 2018) and the company's own writ petitions against CCI in Delhi High Court (W.P.(C) 17348/2025, W.P.(C) 19017/2025), active from at least 14.11.2025 through 19.11.2026 - an open antitrust/regulatory dispute, not a finding of guilt. No adverse media, fraud, or enforcement action by SEBI/RBI/ED could be verified: the web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) throughout this session, so negative-news coverage could not be swept. Credit rating could not be retrieved: ICRA and CRISIL rating-list pages returned 404/error and no rating action page for the company was reachable - rating is null, not confirmed absent.
note: Sanctions: OFAC SDN/consolidated list could not be conclusively screened. The OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) is a JavaScript form returning no results to a plain fetch, and the downloadable sdn.csv was truncated at 6,000 characters (alphabetical, ending around 'F'), so a name beginning with 'M' was never reached. Therefore sanctions_hit is null = NOT SCREENED, not a clean result. UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were not reachable in this session. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found in any source reviewed, but the search backend was down, so rf_supply is null rather than a confirmed negative. Note also that the claimed industry ('IT и электроника') is inconsistent with the company's actual business (steel seamless pipes/tubes, Raigad, Maharashtra) - flagged for the identity/HS team, not a risk verdict. Per rule 2, the CCI and tax litigation are recorded neutrally as 'есть сложности' and are not grounds for rejection.
